widgetdesktop.elf.title: Widget Desktop
widgetdesktop.elf.long: Replaces the stock SwirlOS window manager/desktop (desktop.elf) with a build that supports desktop widgets (/home/user/Widgets).\nRestart SwirlOS after installing. Install needs -f because it takes over a system file. To go back to the stock desktop run: spm os repair
widgetdesktop.elf.author: Swirl
